  • x + 1  (a linear factor)
  • x² + x + 1  (the 3rd–cyclotomic polynomial)
  • x² + 1  (the 4th–cyclotomic polynomial)
  • x² – x + 1  (the 6th–cyclotomic polynomial)
divides P(x).
